error.artwork.notAnImage: That isn't a complete PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture. Choose a different one.
error.artwork.tooLarge: That picture is bigger than {maxMegabytes} MB. Choose a smaller one.
error.capture.cancelled: The snapshot was canceled. Your earlier snapshots are untouched.
error.capture.linkedFolder: A folder in the game is a shortcut, which SavePoint can't safely snapshot or switch through. Replace the shortcut shown below with a real folder or move it out of the game folder, then try again.
error.capture.nestedRepository: {count, plural, one {A folder in the game has its own hidden change-tracking folder, usually from a mod downloaded with a developer tool. SavePoint can't snapshot it.} other {# folders in the game have their own hidden change-tracking folders, usually from mods downloaded with a developer tool. SavePoint can't snapshot them.}} Move the hidden folder shown below out of the game folder, then try again.
error.catalog.corrupt: SavePoint couldn't read one of its files for your games and profiles, and left it as it is. Close and reopen SavePoint to restore the last good copy or start again.
error.compaction.cancelled: Freeing up space was canceled. Nothing was lost.
error.compaction.preempted: Freeing up space paused so something else on this game could go first. Nothing was lost. Free up space again to finish.
error.consentMarker.conflict: That folder already belongs to a different game in SavePoint.
error.consentMarker.missing: This folder isn't confirmed yet. Open Edit game and choose Save changes to confirm it.
error.diskSpace.low: There's not enough free disk space. {os, select, windows {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on drive {drive} and try again.} other {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on the disk that holds the folder below and try again.}}
error.game.notFound: That game isn't in your library anymore. Go back to your games.
error.gameService.alreadyExists: That game is already in your library.
error.gameService.folderMismatch: That {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} holds only {presentCount} of the {recordedCount} files in its latest snapshot, so it may be the wrong one. Check the location, or confirm it if it's right.
error.gameService.gameRunning: {gameName} is running. Close the game, then try again.
error.gameService.noHistoryToReconnect: SavePoint can't find that game's snapshots anymore. Add the game as a new one instead.
error.gameService.pathOverlap: That folder overlaps with {conflictingGameName}, which you already added. Pick a different location for one of them.
error.gameService.profileActive: Switch to another profile or play one, then delete this one.
error.gameService.switching: SavePoint is switching {gameName}'s files. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
error.gameService.reconnectable: That folder has snapshots from a game you removed. Add it as a new game to reconnect them, or choose another folder.
error.git.unavailable: SavePoint can't run the built-in tool it uses for snapshots. Reinstall SavePoint, then open it again.
error.gitOperation.amendNotAvailable: SavePoint can't replace that snapshot right now. Keep the session as a new snapshot or a new profile instead.
error.gitOperation.checkoutFailed: Something else is holding one of the files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again.
error.gitOperation.failed: SavePoint couldn't finish that. Try again. If it keeps happening, include "Copy details for support" in a bug report.
error.gitOperation.recordDamaged: SavePoint's record of this game's folder is damaged, most likely by a power outage or a crash. Your game files weren't changed. If this keeps happening, include "Copy details for support" in a bug report.
error.gitOperation.unreadableFile: SavePoint can't read the file shown below. Check that your account is allowed to read it, then try again.
error.history.pointNotFound: That snapshot isn't in this game's history anymore. Open History again and pick another one.
error.launch.caseClash: Your {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} is on a drive that treats upper and lower case as the same, so it can't hold both {name} and {other}, and this profile's snapshot has both (one is shown below). Nothing changed. Move the game to a drive that tells them apart, or choose another profile.
error.launch.completionNotOffered: SavePoint can't keep this session that way. Pick one of the choices after playing.
error.launch.detachedCaptureNotSupported: You're on an older snapshot of this profile. Go back to its latest snapshot before keeping new progress.
error.launch.dirtyWorkingTree: Some files in your game folders changed since the last snapshot. Choose whether to keep or discard them.
error.launch.fileFolderClash: {kind, select, folderHoldsFiles {SavePoint needs a file named {name} in your {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}}, but there's already a folder with that name, and it holds files that aren't in any snapshot (one is shown below). Nothing changed. Move or delete those files, then try again.} other {SavePoint needs a folder named {name} in your {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}}, but there's already a file with that name that isn't in any snapshot (shown below). Nothing changed. Move or delete it, then try again.}}
error.launch.noActiveSession: SavePoint isn't tracking a play session for this game. Start the game from SavePoint to begin one.
error.launch.sessionMoved: The game's files changed outside this play session, so your new progress can't be kept safely here. Start the game again from SavePoint, from the snapshot you want to keep.
error.launch.sessionStillRunning: The game is still running. Close it, then try again.
error.launch.spawnFailed: SavePoint couldn't start the game. Check the launch settings in Edit game.
error.launch.switchInterrupted: The last switch didn't finish, so the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} has files from two snapshots. Finish the switch, or discard the mix.
error.launch.windowsProgram: This game starts through a Windows program, which SavePoint can't run directly on {os, select, macos {macOS} other {Linux}}. In Edit game, set how to start the game to Through Steam, or choose a program built for {os, select, macos {macOS} other {Linux}}.
error.operation.cancelled: Canceled before it finished. Nothing changed.
error.path.missing: SavePoint still has every snapshot, but can't find the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} anymore. Choose its new location.
error.pathSafety.tier1Blocked: Pick the game's own folder, not the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}}. SavePoint replaces everything inside the folder you choose. Try something like {os, select, windows {C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\YourGame} macos {~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame} other {~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame}}.
error.pathSafety.tier2Blocked: Pick the game's own folder, not the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}}. SavePoint replaces everything inside the folder you choose. Try something like {os, select, windows {C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\YourGame} macos {~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame} other {~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame}}.
error.profile.alreadyExists: You already have a profile with that name. Pick a different name.
error.profile.noPoints: That profile has no snapshot of this folder yet. Open the profile's menu and choose Take a snapshot now.
error.profile.notFound: That profile doesn't exist anymore. Go back to the game's profiles.
error.profile.notLoaded: The {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} isn't holding this profile, and a snapshot copies what your game folders hold now. Switch to this profile, or play it, then take a snapshot.
error.removed.notFound: That snapshot isn't in Recently removed anymore. It may have been deleted when you freed up space, or already brought back.
error.removed.notRestorable: SavePoint can't bring this snapshot back as a profile. It holds only saves, and the game version and mods it was played with belonged to a profile that's gone.
error.storage.defaultFolderHasHistory: SavePoint can't start over in its default folder, shown below, because it already holds snapshots. To use them, choose "Find the folder" and pick it. To start over, move that folder elsewhere first; the snapshots go with it.
error.storage.folderHasLink: That folder has a shortcut in it, shown below, which SavePoint won't go through. Remove the shortcut or choose another folder.
error.storage.noHistoryHere: That folder doesn't hold your snapshots. Choose the folder SavePoint used before, the one with a folder for each game inside.
error.storage.removeFailed: SavePoint couldn't remove the item shown below. It may be read-only or protected. Remove it yourself, then try again.
error.storage.stillReachable: SavePoint can reach its snapshot folder, so there's nothing to find or start over from. To use another folder, move your snapshots from Settings.
error.storage.unreachable: SavePoint can't reach the folder where it keeps your snapshots. If it's on a drive or network share that isn't connected, connect it, then try again.
error.storage.writeFailed: SavePoint couldn't write to the folder shown below. Check that the drive has room and the folder isn't read-only, then try again.
error.storageRelocation.copyFailed: SavePoint couldn't copy everything to the new folder, so it kept using the old one. Nothing was lost. Check that the new location has room and isn't read-only, then try again.
error.storageRelocation.destinationNotEm: That folder already has files in it. Choose an empty folder for your snapshots.
error.storageRelocation.insideInstallFol: That folder is inside SavePoint's install folder, which updating or removing SavePoint deletes along with your snapshots. Choose a folder somewhere else.
error.storageRelocation.moveUnfinished: An earlier move to that folder didn't finish, so it holds a partial copy. Delete what's in it, or choose another folder.
error.storageRelocation.sourceUnreadable: SavePoint can't read or copy the item shown below, so it moved nothing. Fix it or move it out of the snapshot folder, then try again.
error.validation.invalidPayload: Some fields aren't valid yet. Check the name and paths above.
